title: data.list MCP tool
description: Discovers a bounded index of authorized Project evidence; index metadata is a navigation hint that should be followed by data.read for material claims.

project_id.description: Exact Project ID supplied by the evaluation or user request.

type.description: One evidence type to inspect, for example repo_commit, model_snapshot, experiment_run, or article_draft.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding page; paginate only to answer a specific evidence question.

limit.description: Bounded discovery size; prefer a small page such as 20 for evidence assessment.
